outcome.technical: drive-phase.py: executor.waveWidth read through wave_width(config) (absent/1 = the serial drive_phase unchanged; invalid = a stop naming it; auto = max(1, cpu-2) with its basis). wave_step opens a wave when no task is in progress and _wave.select picks >=2 ready tasks (natural id order): wave.start row, each member started and given a tree via manage-worktrees task-add --base HEAD [--path <worktreeRoot>/<repo>-<id>] with a task.worktree row. Each next walks members in id order through advance(..., tree=): gate with run-test-gate --tree, stamp graded in the tree, dispatches collected into one print under WAVE_RULE; a member's decision is parked and becomes pending only when nothing else is due. Before close: integrate-task (task.integrated row, or task.integration.refused row + integration-refused decision retry|block; exit 3 -> undeclared-change decision widen|discard|block, widen runs audit-task scope --files existing+new), integration marked in state before close_task, re-gate on the phase tree when regate is true or null (or after widen), reopen of integrate-task's (task, base) entry on a new start. Terminal member trees whose changed bytes equal the phase tree are removed with task-remove --force, else kept and named; when every member is terminal or blocked, wave.done and the wave is dropped. submit reads the task's tree from the driver state (stateDir) and runs red/take there. Config: KNOWN_EXECUTOR + checks + wave_width_setting in _config_rules, schema, hooks/_config.py DEFAULTS (waveWidth 1) and docstring, README table rows, COMPATIBILITY.md absent-changes-nothing paragraph, init.md step 7.5 writes waveWidth auto into a config it creates. Outside files: _panel_settings.py (three Settings controls + help; the gate allowed it) and PLUGIN-BUILD-GUIDE.md module-map line for drive-phase -> _wave (gate allowed it). settings.js edit for a number-or-auto control was REFUSED by the plan gate (declared by done P105.4), so waveWidth is a text control. Own stages: 21/21 pass; full sweep 322/322 files ok exit 0; ruff, vermin, gate-parity, measure-context --gate exit 0.
outcome.descriptive: a phase now runs its ready disjoint tasks as waves in their own worktrees when executor.waveWidth > 1, and an absent key or width 1 reproduces the 3.2.0 drive
